panels.description: Completed, non-abandoned runs with captured final boards. Advantage is suppressed until the cohort contains at least 20 top-four and 20 bottom-four runs.

targets.queryText: WITH base_runs AS (SELECT r.id AS run_id, r.final_placement, LOWER(REPLACE(m.mode, '_', '')) AS mode, COALESCE(NULLIF(m.backend_version, ''), 'unknown') AS backend_version, COALESCE(NULLIF(m.backend_commit, ''), 'unknown') AS backend_commit, r.final_board_json FROM analytics_player_run r JOIN analytics_match m ON m.id = r.match_id WHERE m.started_at >= $__from AND m.started_at < $__to AND LOWER(REPLACE(m.mode, '_', '')) LIKE ${mode:singlequote} AND COALESCE(NULLIF(m.backend_version, ''), 'unknown') LIKE ${backend_version:singlequote} AND COALESCE(NULLIF(m.backend_commit, ''), 'unknown') LIKE ${backend_commit:singlequote} AND r.status = 'COMPLETED' AND r.abandoned_at IS NULL AND r.final_placement BETWEEN 1 AND 8 AND r.final_board_json IS NOT NULL), totals AS (SELECT mode, backend_version, backend_commit, SUM(CASE WHEN final_placement <= 4 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS top_four_runs, SUM(CASE WHEN final_placement >= 5 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS bottom_four_runs FROM base_runs GROUP BY mode, backend_version, backend_commit), unit_runs AS (SELECT DISTINCT b.run_id, b.final_placement, b.mode, b.backend_version, b.backend_commit, json_extract(unit.value, '$.definitionId') AS definition_id FROM base_runs b JOIN json_each(b.final_board_json) AS unit) SELECT u.mode AS Mode, u.backend_version AS Version, SUBSTR(u.backend_commit, 1, 12) AS "Commit", u.definition_id AS Unit, t.top_four_runs AS "Top 4 sample", t.bottom_four_runs AS "Bottom 4 sample", SUM(CASE WHEN u.final_placement <= 4 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS "Top 4 count", 1.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN u.final_placement <= 4 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / NULLIF(t.top_four_runs, 0) AS "Top 4 rate", SUM(CASE WHEN u.final_placement >= 5 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS "Bottom 4 count", 1.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN u.final_placement >= 5 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / NULLIF(t.bottom_four_runs, 0) AS "Bottom 4 rate", CASE WHEN t.top_four_runs >= 20 AND t.bottom_four_runs >= 20 THEN 100.0 * (1.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN u.final_placement <= 4 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / t.top_four_runs - 1.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN u.final_placement >= 5 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / t.bottom_four_runs) END AS "Delta (pp)", CASE WHEN t.top_four_runs >= 20 AND t.bottom_four_runs >= 20 THEN 'Ready' ELSE 'Low sample' END AS Sample FROM unit_runs u JOIN totals t USING (mode, backend_version, backend_commit) GROUP BY u.mode, u.backend_version, u.backend_commit, u.definition_id ORDER BY CASE WHEN t.top_four_runs >= 20 AND t.bottom_four_runs >= 20 THEN 0 ELSE 1 END, "Delta (pp)" DESC, u.definition_id

COALESCE(NULLIF(m.backend_commit, ''), 'unknown') AS backend_commit, r.final_board_json FROM analytics_player_run r JOIN analytics_match m ON m.id = r.match_id WHERE m.started_at >= $__from AND m.started_at < $__to AND LOWER(REPLACE(m.mode, '_', '')) LIKE ${mode:singlequote} AND COALESCE(NULLIF(m.backend_version, ''), 'unknown') LIKE ${backend_version:singlequote} AND IS NOT NULL), totals AS (SELECT mode, backend_version, backend_commit, SUM(CASE WHEN final_placement <= 4 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS top_four_runs, SUM(CASE WHEN final_placement >= 5 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS bottom_four_runs FROM base_runs GROUP BY mode, backend_version, backend_commit), unit_runs AS (SELECT DISTINCT b.run_id, b.final_placement, b.mode, b.backend_version, b.backend_commit, json_extract(unit.value, '$.definitionId') AS definition_id FROM base_runs b JOIN json_each(b.final_board_json) AS unit) SELECT u.mode AS Mode, u.backend_version AS Version, SUBSTR(u.backend_commit, 1, 12) AS "Commit", u.definition_id AS Unit, t.top_four_runs AS "Top 4 sample", t.bottom_four_runs AS "Bottom 4 sample", SUM(CASE WHEN u.final_placement <= 4 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS "Top 4 count", 1.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN u.final_placement <= 4 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / NULLIF(t.top_four_runs, 0) AS "Top 4 rate", SUM(CASE WHEN u.final_placement >= 5 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS "Bottom 4 count", 1.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN u.final_placement >= 5 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / NULLIF(t.bottom_four_runs, 0) AS "Bottom 4 rate", CASE WHEN t.top_four_runs >= 20 AND t.bottom_four_runs >= 20 THEN 100.0 * (1.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN u.final_placement <= 4 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / t.top_four_runs - 1.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN u.final_placement >= 5 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / t.bottom_four_runs) END AS "Delta (pp)", CASE WHEN t.top_four_runs >= 20 AND t.bottom_four_runs >= 20 THEN 'Ready' ELSE 'Low sample' END AS Sample FROM unit_runs u JOIN totals t USING (mode, backend_version, backend_commit) GROUP BY u.mode, u.backend_version, u.backend_commit, u.definition_id ORDER BY CASE WHEN t.top_four_runs >= 20 AND t.bottom_four_runs >= 20 THEN 0 ELSE 1 END, "Delta (pp)" DESC, u.definition_id

targets.queryText: SELECT r.started_at AS Started, LOWER(REPLACE(m.mode, '_', '')) AS Mode, COALESCE(NULLIF(m.backend_version, ''), 'unknown') AS Version, SUBSTR(COALESCE(NULLIF(m.backend_commit, ''), 'unknown'), 1, 12) AS "Commit", COALESCE(r.analytics_client_id, 'unknown') AS "Anonymous ID", r.status AS Status, CASE WHEN r.abandoned_at IS NULL THEN 'No' ELSE 'Yes' END AS Abandoned, r.final_placement AS Place, r.final_round AS "Final round", COALESCE((SELECT GROUP_CONCAT(json_extract(unit.value, '$.definitionId') || ' ' || json_extract(unit.value, '$.starLevel') || '★', ', ') FROM json_each(r.final_board_json) AS unit), '—') AS "Final board", SUM(CASE WHEN pr.outcome = 'WIN' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) || ' / ' || SUM(CASE WHEN pr.outcome = 'LOSS' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) || ' / ' || SUM(CASE WHEN pr.outcome = 'DRAW' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS "W / L / D", r.id AS "Run ID" FROM analytics_player_run r JOIN analytics_match m ON m.id = r.match_id LEFT JOIN analytics_player_round pr ON pr.run_id = r.id WHERE m.started_at >= $__from AND m.started_at < $__to AND LOWER(REPLACE(m.mode, '_', '')) LIKE ${mode:singlequote} AND COALESCE(NULLIF(m.backend_version, ''), 'unknown') LIKE ${backend_version:singlequote} AND COALESCE(NULLIF(m.backend_commit, ''), 'unknown') LIKE ${backend_commit:singlequote} AND CAST(COALESCE(r.final_placement, '') AS TEXT) LIKE ${placement:singlequote} AND COALESCE(r.analytics_client_id, 'unknown') LIKE ${anonymous_player:singlequote} AND (${completed:singlequote} = '%' OR (${completed:singlequote} = 'COMPLETED' AND r.status = 'COMPLETED') OR (${completed:singlequote} = 'INCOMPLETE' AND r.status <> 'COMPLETED')) AND (${abandoned:singlequote} = '%' OR (${abandoned:singlequote} = 'YES' AND r.abandoned_at IS NOT NULL) OR (${abandoned:singlequote} = 'NO' AND r.abandoned_at IS NULL)) GROUP BY r.id ORDER BY r.started_at DESC, r.id DESC LIMIT 500
